id: \rI need a warm up before the Contest.
en: \rI need a warm up before the Contest.
it: \rMi serve un riscaldamento prima della Gara.

id: \bI can't believe I lost another Contest... How am I ever going to become sucessful?
en: \bI can't believe I lost another Contest... How am I ever going to become sucessful?
it: \bNon ci credo, ho perso un'altra Gara... Come farò mai ad avere successo?

id: \rI can pass on Dragon Ascent to you.
en: \rI can pass on Dragon Ascent to you.

id: \rWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \rWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \rA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \bI'm sorry. It's too dangerous to go through here.
en: \bI'm sorry. It's too dangerous to go through here.
it: \bMi dispiace. È troppo pericoloso passare di qui.

id: \bI hear there is a mysterious place called the Mirage Kingdom somewhere in Route 111. I wish I had time to go visit it.
en: \bI hear there is a mysterious place called the Mirage Kingdom somewhere in Route 111. I wish I had time to go visit it.
it: \bHo sentito che da qualche parte nel Percorso 111 c'è un luogo misterioso chiamato Regno Miraggio. Vorrei avere il tempo di andarlo a visitare.

id: \rEven though the weather is rough, we still manage to grow our own crops every year.
en: \rEven though the weather is rough, we still manage to grow our own crops every year.
it: \rAnche se il clima è difficile, ogni anno riusciamo comunque a coltivare i nostri raccolti.

id: Fallarbor Town\nA farm community with small gardens.
en: Fallarbor Town\nA farm community with small gardens.
it: Brunifoglia\nUna comunità agricola con piccoli orti.

id: \bIf you go through that cave you will end up in Lavaridge Town. It's way too dangerous though.
en: \bIf you go through that cave you will end up in Lavaridge Town. It's way too dangerous though.
it: \bSe attraversi quella grotta, arriverai a Cuordilava. Però è davvero troppo pericoloso.
